note: Adapted from the species description of Silvestri (1914); the original is in Latin, with biological notes in Italian; the queen, soldier and worker are described; measurements in mm as in the original, which uses a comma as the decimal separator.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: body length 12 mm, abdomen width 4 mm; head length 0.94 mm, width (between the compound eyes) 0.91 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.24 mm; hind tibia 1.17 mm. Body pale milky white, the pleurites with red spots; head chestnut, clypeus pale yellowish brown, thoracic nota and abdominal tergites yellowish brown, legs pale yellowish brown, sternites pale yellowish brown. Sternites 1—3 each with a small milky white median spot not reaching the posterior margin; sternite 4 with a transverse milky white spot anteriorly; sternite 5 nearly concolorous; sternite 6 with a nearly milky white median spot. Head length and width between the compound eyes nearly equal, with short hairs; fontanelle rather large, oval, the frontal area around it not paler; compound eyes rather large and protruding; the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye less than the long diameter of the ocellus; clypeus rather inflated. Antennae incomplete in the queen, with 14 segments in all; segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 5 longer again than segment 4. Posterior margin of the pronotum broadly and shallowly concave in the middle; posterior margin of the mesonotum deeply concave, nearly triangular, its posterior corners slightly narrower than those of the mesonotum; inner margin of the tibiae with several spine-like hairs.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 5 mm; head (without mandibles) length 2.08 mm, width 1.32 mm; mandible length 1.38 mm; antenna length 1.82 mm; hind tibia 1.17 mm. Body pale yellowish white, head ochreous yellow to rust-coloured, mandibles black except at the base, labrum mostly straw-coloured, abdomen grey-spotted from gut contents. Head about 4/5 longer than wide, nearly rectangular; above the fontanelle a thick, convex, short-haired projection extends to the level of the base of the mandibles; labrum large, slightly overtopping the tips of the mandibles, its anterior margin broadly and deeply concave, the anterior corners slightly narrowed. Mandible length nearly equal to the head width, rather stout, curved at the apex. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 twice as long as segment 3; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle; apex of the tibiae with several short spine-like hairs besides the apical spur; abdominal tergites with very short and rather dense hairs and a few longer posterior hairs; abdominal cerci prolonged at the apex, nearly cylindrical.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 5 mm; head width 1 mm; antenna length 1.38 mm; hind tibia 0.92 mm. Body milky white, head pale yellowish white, abdomen almost entirely blackish grey from gut contents. Head slightly wider than long; clypeus nearly twice as wide as long, well inflated, with long hairs in a median 1+1 and a marginal 1+1 series and several short hairs. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 very small, ring-like, bare; segment 4 about 1.5 times as long as segment 3; segment 5 hardly longer than segment 4. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum not concave in the middle. Inner margin of the tibiae with a few spine-like hairs at the apex, the outer side of the mid tibia with a stout spine. Abdominal tergites with rather many short hairs and a few short posterior hairs, the pleurites with very fine small hairs and sparse short hairs, the sternites with shorter hairs and a few longer posterior hairs.
